brief:
Israel arrested Mazen Rantisi, a Ramallah physician known for treating poor Palestinians, according to Mondoweiss. Rantisi's daughter said he was targeted because of his work helping Palestinian society remain resilient amid ongoing hardship. The arrest reflects what Palestinians describe as an expanding Israeli security operation across the West Bank.

Rantisi had built a reputation for providing medical care to vulnerable and underserved populations in the city. His detention, the family indicated, underscores the risks faced by community figures who work to sustain Palestinian institutions and social fabric. The case signals broader concerns among Palestinians that no segment of society—including health workers—remains insulated from Israeli targeting.
dek: The arrest and abuse of “doctor of the poor” Mazen Rantisi signal that no one is safe from Israel’s assault on Palestinian life in the West Bank. Rantisi’s daughter says he was targeted because he helps Palestinian society remain resilient.
title: Israel arrests Ramallah physician known as 'doctor of the poor'
